title: Three-step sign-up with validation
prompt: Build a three-step sign-up flow for a mission planner. Each step shows where the user is: "Step 1 of 3", "Step 2 of 3", "Step 3 of 3". Step 1, "Your details": fields "Full name" and "Email", both required. A "Continue" button checks them: an empty name shows "Enter your name." and an email without an @ shows "Enter a valid email.", each next to its field, and the flow does not advance until both are fixed. Step 2, "Your team": choose exactly one of "Solo", "Small crew (2 to 10)" and "Large crew (11 or more)", with "Back" and "Continue" buttons. Step 3, "Confirm": a summary of the name, email and team, a checkbox "I agree to the terms", and a primary button "Create account" that only works once the box is checked; then show "Account created.".
